prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
Finding the "best" dentist for dental implants in Phoenix depends on your specific needs (such as a single-tooth implant versus a full-mouth All-on-4® restoration). Several highly rated and specialized implant centers and dentists in the Phoenix area stand out based on patient reviews, technology, and specialized experience: Aria Dental Implant Center +1
Lead Dentist: Dr. Joe Mehranfar, DMD
Address: 12320 N 32nd St #3, Phoenix, AZ 85032
Highlights: Locally owned and operated, Dr. Mehranfar has treated over 3,000 full-mouth implant cases and serves as an international lecturer on All-on-4® and digital workflows. The center features an in-house digital laboratory, dedicated anesthesia care, and same-day provisional teeth.
Rating: 4.9/5 (578+ reviews)
Website: Aria Dental Implant Center
Scope of Work: If you need a single missing tooth replaced, a general or restorative dentist with strong implant experience (like Central Valley Dentistry or Biltmore Dental Center) is ideal. For a full-arch or full-mouth replacement (All-on-4/All-on-X), a dedicated center or periodontist/prosthodontist (like Aria Dental or Nuvia) is often better equipped. Aria Dental Implant Center +1
Consultation & 3D Imaging: Look for a provider that offers an in-office 3D CBCT scan during your consultation to accurately map your jawbone density and nerve paths. AZ Dentist +1
In-House Labs: Practices with an on-site or digital in-house lab (such as Aria or New Life) can frequently turn around temporary or final zirconia teeth much faster than offices that outsource to third-party labs. www.newsmilearizona.com +1
